current.text: He is projected as Phoenix's sixth man. He comes off the bench behind Jalen Green, Devin Booker, Dillon Brooks and Miles Bridges.
Booker, Green, Brooks and Bridges are expected to take most of the minutes and usage, which leaves little room for him.
Experts say his strong numbers last season came because teammates were injured. When Green, Brooks and Booker all played, his minutes fell to about 23 or 24 and he was not useful.
He only pays off if a player ahead of him gets hurt. If Green, Booker or Brooks misses time, he would start and play about 30 minutes. One expert says he would be three tiers higher as a starter.
Do not draft him in a 12-team league. His ESPN rank of 100 is too high. In a bench role, experts see him as roughly the 150th player and as a stash only in formats that are friendly to stashing.
One expert thinks he should start over Jalen Green because he shoots threes better, handles the ball better and defends better. The same expert expects the team to start Green anyway.
He re-signed with Phoenix for 4 years. The notes disagree on the amount: one says 40 million USD and the other says 48 million USD.
Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league. It plays 4 games in each of our playoff weeks and has the fewest back-to-backs.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.

durable.text: He is not an assertive scorer.
His shooting runs hot and cold. He shot 40% from three for the season but only 30% over the final 15 games. He made under 46% of his two-pointers.

note: Yahoo prices him at 1 USD (rank 117) and ESPN at 2 USD (rank 100). Every expert says not to draft him in a 12-team league because he is a bench player behind four guards and wings. He does not fit any particular build. His projected line gives threes (2.7) and some steals, but it costs FG% (42% on about 10 shots a game). Leave him on waivers at the auction. Early in the season, watch for injuries to Green, Booker, Brooks or Bridges. That would make him a starter at about 30 minutes, and Phoenix's 4-4-4 playoff schedule would add to his value.
